name: Spam Catcher » Scam subject phrases >> Deleted Messages

any.regex: (?i)(virus detec|manhood|enlarge your|erection|prostate|blood sugar|retirement you deserve|drops of th|grow your member|suspended ?package|#?\bid\d{6,}|welcometo-|don'?t miss ?out on savings|deals selling|you have earned a discount|token airdrop|uspsdeliverynotification)

comments: Heuristic spam catcher (priority 200) keyed on scam subject phrases. Catches spam sent from otherwise-generic mailbox domains (gmail/hotmail/comcast) that no domain rule can target, e.g. 'LAST Notice: VIRUS DETECED!', 'Confirmation_Receipt #ID1918305350', 'welcomeTo-LawnCare-ID...'.
Phrases kept tight to avoid false positives on genuine personal mail. No age guard. Validate carefully with a dry run.
